What I do

Four disciplines, one process — frame the problem, build to test, measure the result.

◳

Product Design & Strategy

Problem framing, requirements decomposition, and concept development that turns fuzzy constraints into a defensible direction.

⚙

Prototyping & Fabrication

3- and 5-axis additive manufacturing, CAD, topology optimization, and design-for-fabrication — from scale models to working builds.

⬡

Robotics & Systems

Autonomous workflows simulated and validated in ROS 2 / Gazebo, with sensor integration and physics-accurate testing.

◑

UX & Research

User research, comparative usability testing, and dashboard UX — every iteration carries a clear pass/fail hypothesis.

Selected Work

View all projects
01 — Manufacturing · Sustainability

EcoPrint — 5-Axis 3D Printing

A multi-axis additive workflow that reorients geometry mid-print to eliminate supports — measured 37–44% less support material across overhang-heavy test parts.

↓ 44% peak support-material waste Read the case study
02 — Robotics · Autonomy

The M.A.R.T.I.A.N. Bot

An 8-legged autonomous robot that excavates and builds underground Mars habitats from local regolith — topology-optimized and validated end-to-end in ROS 2 + Gazebo.

★ JWU Symposium recognition, 2024 Read the case study
03 — Medical · Ergonomics

Total Ergonomics™ Micropipette

A user-centered control add-on designed for a lab technician with rheumatoid arthritis. Comparative testing across three prototypes selected a foot-pedal that cut repetitive thumb strain.

3 prototypes · 1 validated design Read the case study
04 — Health-Tech · IoT

BloominBeds Monitoring System

A Raspberry Pi sensor network with a real-time web dashboard that keeps raised garden beds inside safe growing conditions year-round. Team project, JWU Symposium 2024.

Hardware + dashboard UX Read the case study
